Name_EN: Government AI Readiness Index: total score
Definition_EN: Overall score (0-100) of the Oxford Insights Government AI Readiness Index, which assesses how ready governments are to implement AI in the delivery of public services. The 2025 edition examines 69 indicators across 14 dimensions within six pillars: Policy Capacity, Governance, AI Infrastructure, Public Sector Adoption, Development & Diffusion and Resilience.

Name_EN: Government AI Readiness Index: global rank
Definition_EN: Global rank of the government in the Oxford Insights Government AI Readiness Index (1 = highest).
